repos_data.description: A complete web-based remote monitoring and management web site. Once setup you can install agents and perform remote desktop session to devices on the local network or over the Internet.

repo_meta_data.description: Cross-platform Electron desktop studio for Roku developers: remote control, device queries, sideload, telnet console, RALE/App Connector, BrightScript Fiddle, JSON Action Scripts, an `rds` CLI, an MCP server for AI agents, and an internet relay.
